toolsPreview.name: list_endpoints
toolsPreview.description: List the full AI Rook endpoint catalog with prices (52 endpoints: trading intelligence, AI inference via local 456B MoE, blockchain data, dev tools, escrow). START HERE before calling any paid endpoint. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_quote
toolsPreview.description: Get exact price, input schema, and REAL measured latency (from production paid calls) for any AI Rook endpoint BEFORE paying. Agents are risk-averse spenders — quote first, pay second. Free.

toolsPreview.name: escrow_dry_run
toolsPreview.description: Preview a full ERC-8183 escrow job lifecycle on Base WITHOUT touching the chain: exact contract calls with calldata, gas estimates, money split (98% provider / 2% platform), state transitions, reject/refund alternates. Verified against live job 39. Use before creating any escrow job. Free.

toolsPreview.name: sign_receipt
toolsPreview.description: Generate a cryptographically signed proof-of-spend receipt for any USDC payment tx on Base. Server verifies the on-chain Transfer event, then signs with the AI Rook server wallet (EIP-191, ecrecover-verifiable offline). For agent operator audit trails. Free.

toolsPreview.name: preview_market_pulse
toolsPreview.description: FREE taste of the paid /api/market-pulse ($0.05): real BTC price + engine status with CVD/OI/whale fields redacted. Use to evaluate data quality before paying. No payment required.

toolsPreview.name: preview_order_flow
toolsPreview.description: FREE taste of the paid /api/order-flow ($0.25): real price + volume gear with CVD/session levels redacted. Evaluate before paying. Free.

toolsPreview.name: preview_trade_idea
toolsPreview.description: FREE taste of the paid /api/trade-idea ($0.25): strategy name + direction only, entry/stop/target redacted. Evaluate before paying. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_escrow_job
toolsPreview.description: Read the on-chain state of any ERC-8183 escrow job by ID (Open/Funded/Submitted/Completed/Rejected/Expired, client, provider, budget, deliverable hash). Job 39 is our verified live completion. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_attestation
toolsPreview.description: Read the on-chain attestation record for a completed/rejected ERC-8183 job — provider address, agentId, approved flag, timestamp. Proof that the RookAttestationHook fired. Free.

toolsPreview.name: call_paid_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Get payment instructions + live quote for any paid AI Rook endpoint. Returns exact USDC price, x402 payment flow (EIP-3009 sign → retry with X-Payment header), and current measured latency. Does NOT execute the endpoint — use this to plan, then pay via x402 at the endpoint URL. Free.
